virtual_keys.name: ps05-dev
virtual_keys.description: Local development key for the Temporal Evidence Engine. Not a provider credential; it grants nothing outside a gateway bound to 127.0.0.1.

routing_rules.name: groq-with-ollama-fallback
routing_rules.description: Groq models keep their hosted route, then degrade to the local Ollama model instead of failing when Groq refuses or is exhausted. One rule per provider family exists because a single rule that pinned `groq` as its target rewrote every request to Groq - a Mistral call was served by the wrong vendor and nothing said so.

routing_rules.name: mistral-with-ollama-fallback
routing_rules.description: Mistral models route to Mistral and no further: the Ollama fallback is a small local model, and quietly answering a Mistral judge prompt with it would change the verifier's brain mid-run without changing the model name in the record.
